page: Microsoft Azure DC64es_v5 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the DCEV5 family. It is equipped with 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system features 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance configuration does not include local storage, meaning it relies entirely on external storage solutions, though it is designated as Premium Storage capable. There are no integrated graphics processing units present on this server, and it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio provides a balanced allocation of compute and memory resources. This makes the instance suitable for workloads requiring substantial multi-core processing without the extreme memory requirements of higher-ratio systems. Appropriate workloads include enterprise application servers, relational databases utilizing premium remote storage, and general-purpose business-critical applications.
